lines.en: Swishing tail, fly on!

lines.zh: 翅膀划过夜空，掠过地面！
lines.en: Wings slice through the night, skimming the ground.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中悄然滑翔，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Silently glide through the dark, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 掠过树木的阴影，消失无踪！
lines.en: Vanish in the shadow of the trees, gliding by.
Dive towards the water, snatching a salmon.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，准备盘旋巡猎！
lines.en: Wings throb, ready for a hunt.
Lightly sweep past the prey.

lines.zh: 在空中回旋，寻找下一个目标！
lines.en: Loop in the air, seeking the next target.

lines.zh: 栖身于岩洞深处，夜晚巡视！
lines.en: Nest in the cave, patrolling at night.

lines.zh: 轻轻扇动翅膀，展翅高飞！
lines.en: Gently flap, soaring aloft.

lines.zh: 我踩着河面掠过去，翅尖点水。
lines.en: I skim the river, wingtips brushing the water.

lines.zh: 夜里我顺着鲑鱼的洄游线飞。
lines.en: At night I fly along the salmon's migration line.

lines.zh: 栖息于黑暗岩洞，平静如水！
lines.en: Resting in the dark cave, calm as water.

lines.zh: 轻盈地悬停，警惕地观察！
lines.en: Hovering lightly, vigilant.

lines.zh: 在岩石间缓缓滑翔，寻找食物！
lines.en: Sailing between rocks, searching for food.
Looping in the air, enjoying freedom.

lines.zh: 栖息于峭壁之巅，俯瞰大地！
lines.en: Perching atop the cliff, surveying the land.
Lying in wait at the cave entrance.

lines.zh: 在夜间巡视领地，守护家园！
lines.en: Patrolling at night, guarding the territory.

lines.zh: 在岩洞内轻轻蜷缩，享受安宁！
lines.en: Curling up in the cave, enjoying peace.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中缓缓飞行，享受飞行！
lines.en: Flying slowly in the dark, enjoying flight.

lines.zh: 在岩石间轻盈滑行，悠闲自得！
lines.en: Sailing between rocks, leisurely.

lines.zh: 我缩在岩洞里，把长尾盘起来。
lines.en: I curl up in my rock den and coil my long tail.

lines.zh: 我舔着爪尖，回味昨天的鲑鱼。
lines.en: I lick my talons, savoring yesterday's salmon.

lines.zh: 白天我避开阳光，藏在岩缝里。
lines.en: By day I avoid the sun and hide in a crevice.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，听洞外的风。
lines.en: I half-close my eyes and listen to the wind outside.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀叠在背上，安静无事。
lines.en: My wings fold over my back, quiet and unbothered.

lines.zh: 我不怕火，烤一烤反而舒服。
lines.en: Fire does not scare me; a little heat feels good.

lines.zh: 注意到你，眼中闪现光芒！
lines.en: Noting you, eyes glow with interest.
Staring at you, considering.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻微振动，准备攻击！
lines.en: Wings twitch, ready to attack.
Dive towards you, wanting to catch you.
Wings spread, ready for battle.
Watching you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，眼神锐利如刀！
lines.en: Staring at you, eyes sharp as a blade.
Not even salmon shadows outrun me.
Wings outstretched, poised to attack.

lines.zh: 紧盯着你，准备随时出击！
lines.en: Fixed on you, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我探头，只想知道你有没有鱼。
lines.en: I crane my neck, only to see if you have fish.

lines.zh: 你卸下盔甲的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: I noted how you took off your armor.
Wing hurt, hurts!
Tail broken, ouch!
Body hit, ouch
Claws hurt, painful
Scales damaged, hurts
Fall hurt, ouch!
须触断， ouch!
Body hit, hurts
Stomped, ouch!
Wing broken, can't move

lines.zh: 你靠近了，我的鲑鱼梦近了！
lines.en: You're here, my salmon dreams close at hand!

lines.zh: 跟我接近，鱼儿们很快就会来了！
lines.en: Come closer, fish will soon follow.

lines.zh: 鲑鱼的腥味，隔着水都闻到。
lines.en: I smell salmon right through the water.

lines.zh: 我的巢穴藏有鲜美之鱼！
lines.en: My nest hides the freshest fish.
Bring me fish! Quickly.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲遮不住鱼的诱惑！
lines.en: Your armor can't hide the fish's allure.
Night's call, fish come forth.
Enjoy my feast, fish!
Fish, my favorite.
I need only fish, nothing else.
Your touch, my rage!
Stay back, I'll crush you!
Out of my way, you block my path!

lines.zh: 不要挡我的路，我会撞倒你！
lines.en: Move, or I'll knock you down!
Stay back, I'll spark a collision!

lines.zh: 我的身体，会撞得你头晕！
lines.en: My body, it'll knock you dizzy!
Too close, back off!

lines.zh: 我的速度，足以撞破一切！
lines.en: My speed, it'll shatter all!

lines.zh: 我的身体，就是我的武器！
lines.en: My body, it's my weapon!
Don't get too close, I'll knock you down!
Night, find my mate!
My wings, seek a partner!

lines.zh: 让我们的爱，在夜空下延续！
lines.en: Let our love continue under the night sky!

lines.zh: 寻找我的灵魂伴侣，夜行者！
lines.en: Seek my soulmate, the night traveler!

lines.zh: 夜晚的呼唤，回应我的爱！
lines.en: Night's call, answer my love!
My love, it shines in the dark!
Let's meet under the stars!
My love, it crosses the darkness!
My mate, the night's guardian!
Let us be eternal in the darkness!
I've caught a salmon!
Where's the food? Salmon!
Salmon, salmon, salmon!
I'm hungry, find some salmon!
This is my territory, salmon!
Rest time, salmon!
Too sunny, find some salmon!
Nighttime flight, salmon!
My nest, salmon!
Seek the tasty salmon!
Prey is there!
Salmon, my prey!
Target salmon!
Good taste, salmon!
Wait for the salmon!
Salmon here, hunt!
Salmon scent!
Salmon approaching!
Target the salmon, prepare to hunt!
Salmon is my dinner!

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，闻着像鲑鱼。
lines.en: What you hold smells like salmon.

lines.zh: 水面有鱼跃起，我立刻转向。
lines.en: A fish leaps from the water, and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我先观察，再决定要不要靠近。
lines.en: I watch first, then decide whether to come close.

lines.zh: 我的嗅腺锁住了那股腥味。
lines.en: My scent glands have locked onto that fishy smell.
Fix on it, salmon!
Target locked, salmon!
Salmon, notice me!
It's the salmon, target!
Target the salmon, lock on!
Salmon is my prey!
Target the salmon, prepare to attack!
Salmon, I'm hunting you!
Salmon, stop!
Salmon, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 我放慢翅速，保持着距离。
lines.en: I slow my wingbeats and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我先绕到下游，截住逃路。
lines.en: I circle downstream first, cutting off the escape.
The moment it enters the water, I dive.

lines.zh: 我在数它浮上来的间隔。
lines.en: I am counting the gaps between its surfacing.

lines.zh: 鱼尾一摆，我的爪子张开。
lines.en: A flick of the fish tail, and my talons open.
One flick of my tail and I'm gone.
Tail stinger's live. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 无声的翼，先掠过你头顶。
lines.en: Silent wings pass over your head first.
Dragon's fury!
Don't step on my tail; it's venomous.
At night I'm faster than your shadow.
Salmon isn't enough; tonight it's you.
My tail stinger is up — move.
My tail stinger is faster than your blade.
Feel my teeth!
One hook of my talons and the fish leaves the water!
I whip my tail across your hand!
One beat of my wings and you lose your footing!
I bite the fish and will not tangle with you!
Night falls, I emerge.
Night deepens and my tail barb glows.
I am a nocturnal creature.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里钻出，翅膀先张开。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the crevice, wings opening first.
The moon is right; I'm leaving the nest.

lines.zh: 尾针上那点毒，夜里才亮。
lines.en: The venom on my tail only glows at night.
Find food, survive.
Be wary, my domain.
Night is my stage.
Where's the salmon?!

lines.zh: 夜色里，我的影子掠过水面。
lines.en: In the night my shadow sweeps over the water.

lines.zh: 我从峭壁的巢里滑翔下来。
lines.en: I glide down from my nest on the cliff.
The wingbeat arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 这条河归我巡，今晚也是。
lines.en: This river is mine to patrol, tonight as well.

lines.zh: 我在入海口盘旋，等鱼群。
lines.en: I circle the river mouth, waiting for the run.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的鳞片亮了一下。
lines.en: Under the moon, my scales flash once.
Burned, hurts!

lines.zh: 翼膜擦着地面，我滑出很远。
lines.en: My wing membrane scraped the ground and I slid far.
Drowned, cold!
Exploded, hurts!
Arrows, hurts!
Magic, hurts!
Hungry, needs food
Lightning, hurts!
Void hurt, ouch!
